Who We Are

Building a More Compassionate India

InAmigos Foundation was founded on September 23, 2020, by Mr. Govind Shukla (Founder & CEO). It is a Section 8 registered non-profit organization, licensed by the Central Government, with its base at Chhattisgarh.

With a strong network of dedicated professionals, volunteers, and corporate partners, we work tirelessly to bring positive change in society — touching lives through food distribution, education, women empowerment, animal welfare, and environmental sustainability across India.

At InAmigos Foundation, we believe in the power of collective action. Every contribution is directed towards essential causes for social inclusion programs across India's most underserved communities.

Section 8 NGO 80G Certified 12A Certified CSR-1 Registered NITI Aayog ISO 9001:2015

Our Causes

Six Pillars of Change

Every initiative we run is rooted in deep community need — addressing hunger, illiteracy, inequality, and indifference with action, not words.

Project Sewa

Serving Humanity with Compassion

Providing food and clothing to the underprivileged across communities. No one should sleep hungry while we have the power to help.

Progress78%
Support this cause
Project BachpanSala

Nurturing Young Minds, Bright Futures

Ensuring quality education for underprivileged children. Every child deserves the chance to learn, dream, and grow.

Progress65%

Project Jeev

Empowering Lives, Spreading Compassion

Animal welfare — rescuing, protecting, and feeding stray and vulnerable animals. Every living creature deserves kindness.

Progress54%

Project Udaan

Soaring Towards a Brighter Future

Women empowerment through skill development and financial independence. When women rise, families and communities rise with them.

Progress71%

Project Prakriti

Plant for a Better Tomorrow

Environmental conservation and sustainability efforts. We plant trees, protect nature, and build a greener India for future generations.

Building Skills, Building Futures
